test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option with the correct usage of the preposition to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) __was born during 16 November 1945__.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. was born on 16 November 1945 .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "on" is used to refer to specific dates and days.
 
• The correct preposition to use with dates is **"on".**
 
 
• **​Example: **I was born on 8th Nov, 1994.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this question, the correct phrase is **"was born on 16 November 1945"**.

Correct sentence: *The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) was born on 16 November 1945*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Using "in":**

 
 
• **Example:** She was born in November 1945. (Here, "in" is used because it refers to the month and year, not a specific date.)
 
 
 
• **Using "at":**
 
 
• **Example:** The meeting is at 3 PM. (Here, "at" is used to refer to a specific time.)
 
 
 
• **Using "by":**
 
 
• **Example:** The report must be submitted by 16 November 1945. (Here, "by" is used to indicate a deadline.)
